title: Renovated Stone House (T3 Moradia) close to Ansião
description:
Country-House in peaceful landscape close to Ansião & Coimbra

The Country House, about 25 km from Coimbra, has been completely rebuilt from a historic 19th century house in the typical simple Portuguese villa style and thus has all the comfort features of a new building. Characteristics such as the centrally set rubble stone interior wall between living room and kitchen, a juliet balcony on the first floor and the broken stone outer walls are combined with modern energy equipment such as a fully automatic pellet stove for heating of all rooms (between October and April) and a solar thermal system with 300 liter tank for the highly available, ecological hot-water supply. The house is situated on a small street near the forest of the village and so far in a very quiet, relaxing area.

Key data:

- total floor space approx. 115 sqm (outer dimensions 162 sqm) with a ground and upper floor

- three bedrooms with integrated wardrobes (two bedrooms in the upper floor, 13 sqm and 10 sqm), each with a single bed, one bedroom in the ground floor with double bed (14 sqm) and en-suite bathroom with shower

- one bathroom upstairs with shower, one guest toilet in the ground floor

- large kitchen (approx. 20 sqm) with a rustic oak table and all major domestic appliances (refrigerator-freezer, Siemens dishwasher, Siemens induction hob, Siemens oven) and microwave

- nicely decorated spacious living room (35 sqm) with SONY LED TV (SAT receipt Astra 19.2), fully automatic pellet stove, very high-quality living environment with free access to the kitchen and stairway to the two bedrooms

- utility room with solar thermal tank and MIELE washing machine

- rockwool insulation; together with the pellet stove and the solar thermal system, the house has been qualified with an energy certificate of grade "A" (second highest possible rating), and thus even in midsummer there is a pleasant room temperature, and this without air conditioning.

- very low utility costs according to solar energy (for hot water for kitchen and bath) and the pellet stove (for hot water - in case of low solar energy - for kitchen, bath and radiators)

The outdoor area characteristics are the back (east side) paved, arched terrace with beautiful stone mosaic table and front patio (west side) with its big stone wall. There is a parking on the plot, orange trees, olive trees and a fig tree.

The house is situated in a small village close to Ansião and Santiago da Guarda. In Ansião, the district town, all infrastructural facilities (you will find supermarkets like Intermarché and discount stores, restaurants, swimming pool, medical services, Centro da Saude, hairdresser, banks and other service providers) are available. The expressway IC 8 with gateway Ansião is reached in 5 minutes, eastwards leads to the natural river pools, the city of Guarda and the numerous lakes and recreational areas west to Pombal as the nearest bigger town. Northward lies the old historic university city of Coimbra (approx. 35km) and southward the famous city of the Knights Templar, Tomar (approx. 50km). Porto or Lisbon Airport is about 1.5 hours from the house when using the highway. The Atlantic beaches are easily accessible by IC 8 (e. g. approx. 40 minutes for the broad and original dune beach Osso da Baleia). The region of PORTUGAL's heart is, due to its diversity, unique for beach, swimming and hiking holidays and day trips with historic or cultural background.total floor space approx. 115 sqm (outer dimensions 162 sqm) with a ground and upper floor.

Available from 01 November 2026, minimum rental period 9 months, 2 months deposit, rental contract according to Portugiese law, utilties (water, eletricity) on individual consumption. 

Pets and smoking in the house unfortunately not allowed. Please inquire for any questions.
